name: N/action Module
desc: Load the N/action module to execute business logic to update the state of a record. Action APIs emulate NetSuite user interface buttons.

name: N/auth Module
desc: Load the N/auth module to change your NetSuite login credentials.

name: N/cache Module
desc: Load the N/cache module to enable the caching of needed data and improve performance.

name: N/certificateControl Module
desc: Load the N/certificateControl module to enable scripting access to the Digital Certificates list found at Setup > Company > Certificates. You can use this module to find the correct certificate for a subsidiary and check the file type. For more information, see Digital Signing and Uploading Digital Certificates.

name: N/commerce Modules
desc: Load modules in the N/commerce namespace to access different assets in the web store context, such as items and shopping cart. The modules within the N/commerce namespace are supported by the latest version of SuiteCommerce and by SuiteCommerce Advanced 2019.2 onwards.

name: N/compress Module
desc: Load the N/compress module to compress, decompress, and archive files.

name: N/config Module
desc: Load the N/config module to access NetSuite configuration settings. See config.Type for a list of supported configuration pages.

name: N/crypto Module
desc: Load the N/crypto module to work with hashing, hash-based message authentication (hmac), and symmetrical encryption. You can access a set of wrappers for OpenSSL's hash, hmac, cipher, and decipher methods.

name: N/crypto/certificate Module
desc: Load the N/certificate module to sign XML documents or strings with digital certificates using asymmetric cryptography. In addition to signing XML documents, you can create signer and verifier objects and verify signed documents with this module.

name: N/crypto/random Module
desc: Load the N/crypto/random module to work with cryptographically-secure pseudo-random generator methods.
scripts: Client and server scripts; server scripts support SuiteScript 2.1 only

name: N/currency Module
desc: Load the N/currency module to work with exchange rates within your NetSuite account. You can use this module to find the exchange rate between two currencies based on a certain date.

name: N/currentRecord Module
desc: Load the N/currentRecord module to access the record instance that you are currently working on. You can then use the record instance in a client context.

name: N/dataset Module
desc: Load the N/dataset module to create and manage datasets in SuiteAnalytics Workbook. Use this module with the N/workbook module to manage all aspects of your datasets and workbooks in SuiteAnalytics Workbook.

name: N/documentCapture Module
desc: Load the N/documentCapture module to extract text content from supported documents. This module lets you programmatically extract structured content and key information from a variety of document types (such as invoices, receipts, contracts, and so on).

name: N/email Module
desc: Load the N/email module to send email messages from within NetSuite. You can use the email module to send regular, bulk, and campaign email.

name: N/encode Module
desc: Load the N/encode module to convert a string to another type of encoding. See encode.Encoding for a list of supported character set encoding.

name: N/error Module
desc: Load the N/error module to create your own custom SuiteScript errors. Use these custom errors in try-catch statements to abort script execution.

name: N/file Module
desc: Load the N/file module to work with files in NetSuite.

name: N/format Module
desc: Load the N/format module to convert strings into a specified format and to parse formatted data into strings.

name: N/format/i18n Module
desc: Load the N/format/i18n module to format currency.

name: N/http Module
desc: Load the N/http module to make http calls.

name: N/https Module
desc: Load the N/https module to make https calls. You can also use this module to encode binary content or securely access a handle to the value in a NetSuite credential field.

name: N/https/clientCertificate Module
desc: Load the N/clientCertificate module to send SSL requests with a digital certificate.

name: N/keyControl Module
desc: Load the N/keyControl module to access key storage.

name: N/llm Module
desc: Load the N/llm module to use generative artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities. You can use this module to send requests to the large language models (LLMs) supported by NetSuite and to receive LLM responses to use in your scripts.

name: N/log Module
desc: Load the N/log module to access methods for logging script execution details. Module members are also supported by the global log Object.
scripts: Client and server scripts Limitations apply to client scripts

name: N/machineTranslation Module
desc: Load the N/machineTranslation module to translate text into supported languages using generative AI.

name: N/manufacturing/productionCharges Module
desc: Load the N/manufacturing/productionCharges module to update unit costs of manufacturing charges on Assembly Build, Work Order Close, Work Order Completion transactions.

name: N/pgp Module
desc: Load the N/pgp module to send secure messages to one or multiple receivers.

name: N/piremoval Module
desc: Load the N/piremoval module to remove personal information (PI) from system notes, workflow history, and specific field values.
permissions: Remove Personal Information Create Remove Personal Information Run

name: N/plugin Module
desc: Load the N/plugin module to load custom plug-in implementations.

name: N/portlet Module
desc: Load the N/portlet module to resize or refresh a form portlet.

name: N/query Module
desc: Load the N/query module to create and run searches using the SuiteAnalytics Workbook query process.

name: N/record Module
desc: Load the N/record module to work with NetSuite records.

name: N/recordContext Module
desc: Load the N/recordContext module to get the context type of a record.

name: N/redirect Module
desc: Load the N/redirect module to redirect users to a URL, a Suitelet, a record, a task link, a saved search, or an unsaved search.

name: N/render Module
desc: Load the N/render module to create forms or email from templates and to print to PDF or HTML.
permissions: Advanced PDF/HTML Templates Custom PDF Layouts

name: N/runtime Module
desc: Load the N/runtime module to access runtime settings for company, script, session, system, user, or version.

name: N/scriptTypes/restlet Module
desc: Load the N/scriptTypes/restlet module to create custom handling for your RESTlet script.

name: N/search Module
desc: Load the N/search module to create and run on-demand or saved searches and analyze and iterate through the search results. You can search for a single record by keywords, create saved searches, search for duplicate records, or return a set of records that match filters you define.
permissions: Perform Search Persist Search Publish Search

name: N/sftp Module
desc: Load the N/sftp module to connect to a remote FTP server using SFTP and transfer files.
permissions: Key Access (needed when public key authentication is used)

name: N/sso Module
desc: Note: As of NetSuite 2025.1, the support ended for the SuiteSignOn feature, which means the N/sso module is also no longer supported. Load the N/sso module to generate outbound single sign-on (SuiteSignOn) tokens.

name: N/suiteAppInfo Module
desc: Load the N/suiteAppInfo module when you want to access information related to SuiteApps and Bundles.

name: N/task Module
desc: Load the N/task module to create tasks and place them in the internal NetSuite scheduling or task queue. Use this module to schedule scripts, run Map/Reduce scripts, import CSV files, merge duplicate records, and execute asynchronous workflows.

name: N/task/accounting/recognition Module
desc: Load the task/accounting/recognition module to merge revenue arrangements or revenue elements. This module lets you combine revenue arrangements or revenue elements from multiple sources to represent a single contract for revenue allocation and recognition.

name: N/transaction Module
desc: Load the N/transaction module to void transactions.

name: N/translation Module
desc: Load the N/translation module to load NetSuite Translation Collections in SuiteScript.

name: N/ui/dialog Module
desc: Load the N/dialog module to create a modal dialog that is displayed until a button on the dialog is pressed.

name: N/ui/message Module
desc: Load the N/message module to display a message at the top of the screen under the menu bar.

name: N/ui/serverWidget Module
desc: Load the N/serverWidget module to work with the user interface within NetSuite.

name: N/url Module
desc: Load the N/url module to determine URL navigation paths within NetSuite or format URL strings.

name: N/util Module
desc: Load the N/util module to manually access util methods. Module members are also supported by the global util Object.

name: N/workbook Module
desc: Load the N/workbook module to create and manage workbooks in SuiteAnalytics Workbook. Use this module with the N/dataset module to manage all aspects of your datasets and workbooks in SuiteAnalytics Workbook.

name: N/workflow Module
desc: Load the N/workflow module to initiate new workflow instances or trigger existing workflow instances.

name: N/xml Module
desc: Load the N/xml module to validate, parse, read, and modify XML documents.
